title: MarkIt: Training-Free Visual Markers for Precise Video Temporal Grounding

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding

evidence.quote: Experiments conducted on multiple mainstream moment retrieval and highlight detection benchmarks demonstrate that \MarkIt {} achieves state-of-the-art results, delivering consistent temporal grounding improvements across a wide range of existing models.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Video temporal grounding (VTG) is a fundamental task in video understanding that aims to localize the start and end timestamps of an event described by a natural-language query within an untrimmed video.

evidence.quote: # Introduction Video temporal grounding (VTG) is a fundamental task in video understanding that aims to localize the start and end timestamps of an event described by a natural-language query within an untrimmed video.

background_setup.summary: VTG requires models to align linguistic descriptions with temporally coherent visual evidence, which is challenging due to complex dynamics and ambiguous visual cues, demanding joint reasoning over visual semantics and temporal structures.

evidence.quote: VTG requires models to align linguistic descriptions with temporally coherent visual evidence, which is challenging due to complex dynamics and ambiguous visual cues, demanding joint reasoning over visual semantics and temporal structures.
